hidden.reason: Hiscock's simplest model, a hole made and removed by two shells, another spacetime than the one embedded.

hidden_surfaces.reason: Each chart of Hiscock's hole holds part of the spacetime: the ingoing chart ends at v_0 = 8, so the last moment, v - r = 11, has no part in it; the outgoing chart begins on the surface of pair creation, which the moments before v - r = -1 do not reach; and the flat space after the hole holds only the last.

flat_moments.reason: Hiscock's hole leaves flat space behind: at the last moment of its movie the flat disc inside the last ray has reached r = 3m_0/2 and the mass still inside the rim is under m_0/20.
